description: List reviews across connected accounts (applicable to Google Business, Trustpilot, and similar review platforms). Fan-out queries all matching accounts in parallel. Returns review interaction objects with id, reviewer name, rating, text, and timestamp. Use social_api_reply_to_review to respond. Returns 501 for Instagram, Facebook, and platforms without review support. Supports account_id or platform filter and pagination.

account_id.description: Connected account ID (optional, omit to fan-out across all accounts)

name: social_api_get_reviews
title: Get Reviews
